_comment: Hand-written WRONG or UNSUPPORTED claims (not from an LLM). Citations point at the real span the claim twists, so they get the same premise as real claims. Gold labels in labels.csv.

claims.claim: By default, urllib3 retries requests 5 times.
claims.citation: By default, urllib3 will retry requests 3 times

claims.claim: By default, urllib3 follows up to 10 redirects.
Specifying retries=False keeps the redirect logic of urllib3 enabled.
claims.citation: To disable all retry and redirect logic specify `retries=False`

claims.claim: Specifying redirect=False disables the retrying logic of urllib3.
claims.citation: To disable redirects but keep the retrying logic, specify `redirect=False`

claims.claim: urllib3 never retries idempotent requests automatically.
claims.citation: urllib3 can automatically retry idempotent requests
urllib3 can automatically retry idempotent requests

claims.claim: A retry policy set at the PoolManager level cannot be overridden per request.
claims.citation: You can still override this pool-level retry policy by specifying `retries` to `request()`.

claims.claim: The urllib3 Retry class is thread-safe.
claims.citation: For more granular control you can use a `Retry` instance.

claims.claim: By default, urllib3 waits 1 second between retries.
claims.citation: By default, urllib3 will retry requests 3 times
